description: Single storey rear extension with an overall depth of 5m, a maximum height of 3m, and an eaves height of 3m. (PRIOR APPROVAL)
decision_conditions: The Council consider that the impact of the proposed development by reason of its excessive depth and proximity to the shared boundary would unacceptably harm the amenity of the adjacent neighbours at No.15 Sedgefield Crescent, Romford by reason of visual intrusion, loss of outlook and overbearing effect on this property.

This written notice indicates that the proposed development would not comply with condition A.4 of Schedule 2 Part 1 Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015.  It is important to note that this written notice does not indicate whether or not the proposed development would comply with any of the other limitations of conditions of Schedule 2 Part 1 Class A.
The applicant has the right to an appeal against this notice to the Planning Inspectorate, see details below.
The applicant should note that the drawings accompanying the application do not reflect the variation in ground level within the site and this would be beneficial for any re-submission.
